verdict.headline: Services growth hits four-year high as stocks bounce but close the week in the red
verdict.label: HOLD — 0 of 3 regime triggers breached: 30Y 5.25% (below 5.30% gate); Brent $93.64 (below $94 gate); BTC ~$78,100 (above $62K floor). Flash composite PMI 56.0 (52-month high); S&P +0.43% Friday but −1.4% weekly; Nasdaq −2.0% weekly; NVDA print in 5 sessions.
verdict.rationale_short: Flash composite PMI 56.0 (fastest US growth since April 2022) provided Friday's catalyst: services jumped to 56.8 (20-month high) while manufacturing slipped to 53.2 on supply-chain extension at near 4-year worst. Brent rose sharply on Trump's Iran 'economic warfare' announcement but closed at $93.64 — 36 cents below the formal $94 regime trigger. Two consecutive weekly losses (S&P −1.4%, Nasdaq −2.0%) reflect persistent bond volatility: the 30Y holds at 5.25%, 5bps from the 5.30% trigger that would complete the stagflation framework alongside Brent. BTC hit $79,525 intraday on Clarity Act momentum (best weekly gain since March 2024) but the $80K ceiling remains unbroken on a close. ROST delivered a massive Q2 beat (EPS $2.66 vs $1.94; comps +10%) and raised FY guidance; analysts boosted targets. Setup into Monday: Bessent press conference on Iran sanction details; NVDA print in five sessions (Aug 26 AH); Jackson Hole Aug 27–29 Warsh keynote.

trade_setups.asset: 30Y Treasury — 5bps from completing the stagflation framework
trade_setups.thesis: The two-indicator stagflation framework (Brent >$94 AND 30Y >5.30%) has one leg at the threshold: Brent at $93.64 is 36 cents below the formal trigger; 30Y at 5.25% is 5bps from the rate leg. Bifurcated PMI (services 56.8 hot, manufacturing supply-chain delays at near 4-year worst) is the precise configuration that keeps the September Fed path contested and the long end supply-driven. Bessent's Monday press conference on 'Operation Economic Fury' Iran sanction details is the proximate catalyst: escalated secondary sanctions risk pushing Brent through $94 and the 30Y completing the configuration with it.
trade_setups.entry: 5.25% current; 5.30% is the formal trigger for the full stagflation read. 5.20% is where Bessent's doubled buyback ($4B/operation) supply-signal begins pricing in structural containment.
trade_setups.invalidation: Bessent delivers credible de-escalation framework, Brent retreats below $91, and 30Y pulls back below 5.10%. A soft pre-Jackson Hole macro surprise compressing September hike odds below 20%.
trade_setups.horizon: Monday Bessent press conference; Aug 26 NVDA print; Jackson Hole Aug 27–29 Warsh keynote

trade_setups.asset: BTC — $80K ceiling test in thin weekend liquidity
trade_setups.thesis: BTC hit $79,525 intraday Friday — the closest approach to $80K since the Clarity Act momentum began. Weekend liquidity runs 20–30% below weekday depth. A close above $80K would be the structural breakout the current cycle has been building toward (22% weekly gain, best since March 2024). The Clarity Act has no Senate floor date, so the legislative catalyst remains forward-looking; weekend price action is sentiment-driven, not catalyst-driven.
trade_setups.entry: BTC ~$78,100 at Friday close; $80K is the breakout level; $74K is the first support test.
trade_setups.invalidation: Brent escalation to $97+ (liquidity rotation from risk assets into defensive), or a Clarity Act Senate procedural block Monday. A Sunday/Monday close below $74K confirms momentum exhaustion.
trade_setups.horizon: Weekend through Monday open; Senate schedule week of Aug 24

bear_case: Two back-to-back weekly losses (S&P −1.4%, Nasdaq −2.0%) driven by bond volatility — not geopolitics or earnings misses. The 30Y at 5.25% is 5bps from completing the stagflation configuration when Brent reclaims $94; Bessent's Monday press conference on Iran sanctions is the first catalyst. Bifurcated PMI (services 56.8 booming, manufacturing supply-chain delays at near 4-year worst) is the precise configuration that keeps September hike pricing contested. VIX at 16.01 rose 7.5% on a green Friday — options desks are buying protection ahead of the NVDA print and Warsh keynote that equity cash has not yet priced. The $93.64 Brent close is 36 cents from the formal $94 trigger with no Iran diplomacy channel open heading into a weekend; 36 cents of buffer is not a margin of safety. Level that flips this read: Brent back below $91 AND 30Y back below 5.10%, both within 48 hours of Monday's open.
